SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT COUNT(*) as store_count_2024 FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(*) as store_count_2025 FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025

-- Sales for P01 FY2024/25
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024
),
period_dates_2024 AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date 
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period = 1
),
period_dates_2025 AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date 
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 1
),
sales_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as gross_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) as returns
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN period_dates_2024 pd ON fsl.sale_date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date
  WHERE ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
),
sales_2025 AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as gross_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) as returns
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN period_dates_2025 pd ON fsl.sale_date BETWEEN pd.period_start_date AND pd.period_end_date
  WHERE ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
)
SELECT 
  s24.gross_sales - s24.returns as net_sales_2024,
  s25.gross_sales - s25.returns as net_sales_2025,
  ((s25.gross_sales - s25.returns) - (s24.gross_sales - s24.returns)) / (s24.gross_sales - s24.returns) * 100 as growth_pct
FROM sales_2024 s24, sales_2025 s25

-- Verify store lists are consistent
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT l24.store_id) as stores_in_2024_list,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l25.store_id) as stores_in_2025_list,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l24.store_id IS NOT NULL AND l25.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN l24.store_id END) as stores_in_both
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 l24
FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 l25 ON l24.store_id = l25.store_id

-- Alternative calculation using aggregation by period
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024
),
sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as gross_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) as returns
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 1
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  gross_sales - returns as net_sales
FROM sales_by_period
ORDER BY fiscal_year

-- Check for any store closures during the periods
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024
),
period_dates_2024 AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date 
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period = 1
),
period_dates_2025 AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date 
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 1
)
SELECT 
  'FY2024/25 P01' as period,
  COUNT(*) as closures_during_period
FROM ref_store_closure rsc
INNER JOIN period_dates_2024 pd ON rsc.closure_start_date <= pd.period_end_date AND rsc.closure_end_date >= pd.period_start_date
WHERE rsc.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'FY2025/26 P01' as period,
  COUNT(*) as closures_during_period
FROM ref_store_closure rsc
INNER JOIN period_dates_2025 pd ON rsc.closure_start_date <= pd.period_end_date AND rsc.closure_end_date >= pd.period_start_date
WHERE rsc.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)

-- Check stores with zero sales in either period
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024
),
stores_with_sales_2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 1
),
stores_with_sales_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 1
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as stores_with_sales_both_periods
FROM stores_with_sales_2024
INNER JOIN stores_with_sales_2025 USING (store_id)

-- Final LFL growth calculation with rounding
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2024
),
sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as gross_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) as returns,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 1
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(((SELECT net_sales FROM sales_by_period WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26') - 
          (SELECT net_sales FROM sales_by_period WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25')) / 
         (SELECT net_sales FROM sales_by_period WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25') * 100, 2) 
  as lfl_growth_percent
